question_text: Differentiate between primary and secondary antibodies.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Primary antibodies
steps.why: The primary antibody is the one chosen to recognise the substance being looked for.
common_mistakes: Saying primary antibodies bind other antibodies.
Confusing primary with the patient's own antibodies.
steps.memory_tip: Primary binds the antigen of interest.
lines: Primary antibodies react with the antigens

steps.label: Secondary antibodies
steps.why: The secondary antibody carries the label, so it makes the primary antibody visible.
common_mistakes: Saying secondary antibodies bind the antigen.
Giving only one of the two.
steps.margin_note: Keep the contrast in the same words.

lines.text: Secondary antibodies react with the primary ones

insider_note: The difference is WHAT each one binds to. One binds the antigen, the other binds the first antibody.
